body: Just guessing that the `$ref` isn't being resolved in the right file.  Does it work if you reference `./responses.yaml#/definitions/Error`?  (Not that I think you should do this in the end, just guessing about the cause.)

Yes it work by setting `./responses.yaml#/definitions/Error` in the responses.yaml file.
Will use this workaround thanks :)

issue.title: Transitive refs fail to resolve on local file
issue.body:
From go-swagger/go-swagger#1429 (see test case there)
Test case on $ref for full response
When response $ref points to another file (./responses.yaml#responses/BadRequest) where a new indirection is declared locally (to #/definitions/Error).

Fails to resolve ./responses.yaml/#definitions/Error

Declaring explicitly './responses.yaml#/definitions/Error' in responses.yaml works around the problem.
